*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: vision_client.py
+import base64
+import mimetypes
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+DEFAULT_VISION_MODEL = "gpt-4.1-mini"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class VisionClientConfig:
+    api_key: str
+    model: str = DEFAULT_VISION_MODEL
+    timeout: float = 60.0
+
+
+def load_config() -> VisionClientConfig:
+    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "").strip()
+    if not api_key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    model = os.getenv("OPENAI_VISION_MODEL", DEFAULT_VISION_MODEL).strip() or DEFAULT_VISION_MODEL
+    timeout = float(os.getenv("OPENAI_VISION_TIMEOUT", "60"))
+    return VisionClientConfig(api_key=api_key, model=model, timeout=timeout)
+
+
+def _guess_mime_type(path: Path) -> str:
+    mime_type, _ = mimetypes.guess_type(str(path))
+    if mime_type:
+        return mime_type
+    return "application/octet-stream"
+
+
+def image_file_to_data_url(image_path: str) -> str:
+    path = Path(image_path)
+    data = path.read_bytes()
+    mime_type = _guess_mime_type(path)
+    encoded = base64.b64encode(data).decode("ascii")
+    return f"data:{mime_type};base64,{encoded}"
+
+
+def build_static_image_payload(image_path: str, prompt: str = "Describe this image.") -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    return [
+        {"type": "input_text", "text": prompt},
+        {"type": "input_image", "image_url": image_file_to_data_url(image_path)},
+    ]
+
+
+def build_visual_understanding_payload(image_path: str, prompt: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    return build_static_image_payload(image_path=image_path, prompt=prompt)
+
+
+def _extract_output_text(response_json: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    texts: List[str] = []
+    for item in response_json.get("output", []):
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"}:
+                text = content.get("text")
+                if text:
+                    texts.append(text)
+    if texts:
+        return "\n".join(texts)
+    return response_json.get("output_text", "") or ""
+
+
+def analyze_image(image_path: str, prompt: str = "Describe this image.", config: Optional[VisionClientConfig] = None) -> str:
+    cfg = config or load_config()
+    payload = {
+        "model": cfg.model,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": build_static_image_payload(image_path, prompt),
+            }
+        ],
+    }
+    headers = {
+        "Authorization": f"Bearer {cfg.api_key}",
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    }
+    response = requests.post(OPENAI_API_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=cfg.timeout)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return _extract_output_text(response.json())
+
+
+def get_local_vision_config() -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    cfg = load_config()
+    return {"provider": "openai", "api_url": OPENAI_API_URL, "model": cfg.model, "timeout": cfg.timeout}
+
*** End Patch

+import base64
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini"
+
+
+def _image_to_data_url(path: str) -> str:
+    with open(path, "rb") as f:
+        raw = f.read()
+    encoded = base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii")
+    ext = os.path.splitext(path)[1].lower().lstrip(".") or "png"

+    return f"data:image/{mime};base64,{encoded}"
+
+
+def score_image_safety(image_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    data_url = _image_to_data_url(image_path)
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "input_text", "text": "Assess this image for unsafe or policy-sensitive visual content. Return JSON with keys: unsafe (boolean), score (number from 0 to 1), categories (array of strings), rationale (string)."},
+                    {"type": "input_image", "image_url": data_url},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+        "text": {"format": {"type": "json_object"}},
+    }
+    headers = {
+        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    }
+    resp = requests.post(OPENAI_API_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=60)
+    resp.raise_for_status()
+    data = resp.json()
+
+    text = ""
+    for item in data.get("output", []):
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"}:
+                text += content.get("text", "")
+
+    if not text:
+        raise RuntimeError("No JSON response returned by OpenAI")
+
+    return json.loads(text)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: python score_image_safety.py <image_path>")
+    result = score_image_safety(sys.argv[1])
+    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import base64
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from urllib import request
+
+
+def detect_image_text(image_path: str) -> str:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        image_b64 = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode("ascii")
+    payload = {
+        "model": "gpt-4.1-mini",
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "input_text", "text": "Extract all visible text from this image. Return only the text."},
+                    {"type": "input_image", "image_url": f"data:image/png;base64,{image_b64}"},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+    }
+    req = request.Request(
+        "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses",
+        data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        method="POST",
+    )
+    with request.urlopen(req) as resp:
+        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
+    parts = []
+    for item in data.get("output", []):
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") in ("output_text", "text"):
+                parts.append(content.get("text", ""))
+    return "".join(parts).strip()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: detect_image_text.py IMAGE_PATH")
+    print(detect_image_text(sys.argv[1]))
*** End Patch

+import argparse
+import base64
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from urllib import request, error
+
+
+def detect_labels(image_path: str, max_labels: int = 10):
+    api_key = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_VISION_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("GOOGLE_CLOUD_VISION_API_KEY is required")
+
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        image_bytes = f.read()
+
+    payload = {
+        "requests": [
+            {
+                "image": {"content": base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode("ascii")},
+                "features": [
+                    {
+                        "type": "LABEL_DETECTION",
+                        "maxResults": max_labels,
+                    }
+                ],
+            }
+        ]
+    }
+
+    req = request.Request(
+        f"https://vision.googleapis.com/v1/images:annotate?key={api_key}",
+        data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
+        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        method="POST",
+    )
+
+    try:
+        with request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
+            data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
+    except error.HTTPError as e:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Google Cloud Vision API error: {e.read().decode('utf-8', 'ignore')}") from e
+
+    annotations = data.get("responses", [{}])[0].get("labelAnnotations", [])
+    return [
+        {
+            "description": item.get("description"),
+            "score": item.get("score"),
+            "mid": item.get("mid"),
+        }
+        for item in annotations
+    ]
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Detect labels in a static image using Google Cloud Vision API.")
+    parser.add_argument("image_path")
+    parser.add_argument("--max-labels", type=int, default=10)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    labels = detect_labels(args.image_path, args.max_labels)
+    json.dump(labels, sys.stdout, indent=2)
+    sys.stdout.write("\n")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
